mandatoryDailyScope.rule: Every operating run must review conversion integrity, exact zero-exposure cohorts, the latest 24 hours versus the previous 24 hours, the latest complete 7-day window, active SEO experiments, merchant-link health, crawl discovery, production health and due measurement gates. mandatoryDailyScope.conversionFirst: Amazon or authorized CJ earnings are the objective. Every commercial page must retain a truthful, exact or clearly labeled fallback purchase path in the first viewport and pass the structural conversion audit.
mandatoryDailyScope.seoEvidenceRule: Judge tracked URL cohorts exactly. Do not replace an exact 24-hour, 48-hour or cohort analysis with a site-wide headline metric, and do not rewrite protected winners or active title experiments before their gate.
mandatoryDailyScope.serverResourcePriority: Affiliate is the primary revenue service and has first claim on server capacity. Keep its non-root systemd service stable on loopback port 3011; reduce or defer non-revenue workloads first when measured memory pressure appears.

conversionIntegrityP0.trigger: https://baby.madabase.com/guides/ergobaby-omni-breeze-positions-by-age received traffic while its purchase path was missing or too far below the first viewport.
conversionIntegrityP0.rootCause: A drifted Amazon listing caused the old Omni Breeze ASIN to be suppressed; the first repair supplied a fallback but did not preserve the exact product after a new exact listing became available. A stale Amazon Creators API snapshot could also overwrite exact catalog data. The first sticky-commerce implementation additionally carried lg:hidden, so desktop visitors never received the persistent purchase path after scrolling.
conversionIntegrityP0.remediation: Restored the exact Ergobaby Omni Breeze listing, ASIN B0931ZY7DK, Onyx Black, with Baby tag madababy-20. The stale Creators API snapshot can no longer override an exact catalog ASIN. Release 309afe0 keeps direct buying language in the decision path, moves detailed source and non-hands-on methodology to the bottom, labels first-screen and sticky CTAs with a compact purchase-link line, and makes the entire responsive sticky bar clickable after the first CTA leaves view. The dock now works on desktop and mobile, hides at the footer and records sticky-bottom clicks separately.
conversionIntegrityP0.targetPage: The positions-by-age guide now exposes exact Omni Breeze commerce in the first viewport and links to ASIN B0931ZY7DK with tag madababy-20. The exact product review uses the same verified offer.
